listing.name: A2 Racer IV: De politie slaat terug! (PC 2000) / NostalgiaRealm WebAssembly port
listing.summary: Browser and desktop port of A2 Racer 4 - De politie slaat terug! (Davilex, 2000) in WebGL and Three.js: spel.dat recompiled from x86 to WebAssembly, the menu rewritten by hand, original assets, Dutch. Includes the full decompile. Developed through AI-assisted reverse engineering with Claude.
